observations: Energy Fuels expected about 1.6M lb finished U3O8 by June 30, already within its 1.5-2.5M lb full-year 2026 guidance range.
It produced 99.9% terbium oxide at pilot scale after dysprosium work, with OEM/magnet-manufacturer validation requested.
Phase-1 modifications target commercial heavy-REE capability; management described 2027 timing subject to approvals/feedstock.

The company announced a conditional commitment for up to $725M of 20-year senior-secured U.S. government debt for critical-material expansion, subject to diligence, agreements, conditions and approvals.
risks: commercial heavy-REE scale-up is not yet proven
feedstock and regulatory approvals constrain expansion
conditional financing is not closed financing
contradictions: Pilot-scale heavy-REE technical success is materially earlier than commercial-scale economic proof.
unknowns: commercial yields/costs and customer qualification at scale

recommendation.reason: Primary evidence materially improves execution/catalyst lineage; financial scoring remains Alpha-owned.
